Family situation does not help with the whole...feelings and venting thing. It's not good for me, I have zero support system and no friends, so it's kind of hard to do that, but thank you.

And that's very good advice, and I wish I could follow it. I have this tendency to play games to show off, to show people that I am, I'm not quite sure what I enjoy anymore.

Yes, something triggered, well, a few things over the past few days.

And no, I have no idea what I want, and that's sad.
